description: Search OpenAlex and arXiv for literature on a research topic, append the deduplicated results to the project's reading-list.md, and optionally download arXiv PDFs into papers/_inbox/.

path.description: Absolute path to the research project folder (the folder that contains papers/, notes/ and reading-list.md).

query.description: Search query sent to OpenAlex and arXiv.

download.description: Download arXiv PDFs into papers/_inbox/ (default true).

max_downloads.description: Maximum number of PDFs downloaded in this call (0-50, default 2). arXiv is fetched serially at about 3 seconds per paper, so the count is bounded to keep the call within the host time limit. Repeat the call to continue.
